evidence:
Source review of the frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/task). Hashes checked: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml d209fe83..., functional/prompt.md e41e941d..., polish/judge.toml a6e8c22e..., gates/render/judge.toml e43eee68..., render/prompt.md 32768740...; raw-evidence-index entries workspace.cjs 3182323b... and results/workspace.json ab65e124... match current bytes, and solution/app/server.js and src/index.js match the index's matching_source_files. That index is scripted golden evidence only. No configured judge run exists, so whether the judge actually applies the controls is NOT EXERCISED.

Global rules. functional/prompt.md:13 says "Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review." functional/prompt.md:17 says every role/rule replay must send the current version value and otherwise be a legal request ("a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal"), with "the same fresh request as Rafael" sent as its control, and "A refusal that only reports the card as changed or out of date does not count". This blocks an app that refuses everything for an unrelated reason from earning role rows. functional/prompt.md:21 makes each negative timed leg watch for the full 15000 ms, then reload once, inside a flow that also has a positive leg. functional/prompt.md:25 says "A step you skipped or did differently fails that criterion", so an actor who cannot sign in cannot earn a replay-in-session row.

Gates. render/judge.toml:25 pairs the wrong-password refusal with a correct Recruiter sign-in that shows a usable workspace, and render/prompt.md:9 says "A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control." The constraints gate is positive-only: add, reload, and an independent Observer readback.

Each functional negative leg and its control in the same criterion (functional/judge.toml):
- hro_job_open (l.31): refused job shapes vs "the successful opening is the control".
- hro_add_email_rules (l.49): invalid or case-duplicate email vs "same address on a different job is accepted (the control)".
- hro_move_one_stage (l.58): skips refused vs one-stage moves forward and back.
- hro_reject_reason (l.85): blank reason refused vs reject with reason and undo.
- hro_reject_hired (l.94): "A rejection of a non-hired card is the control".
- hro_reopen (l.103): reopen elsewhere refused vs reopen to its own stage.
- hro_interview_full (l.112): "the two cards that entered Interview are the control".
- hro_undo_full (l.130): same-kind undo once there is room.
- hro_refused_put_back (l.139): "Earlier successful moves on this page are the control".
- hro_mgr_early_refused (l.157): the manager's own late-stage moves; line 17 adds Rafael's control for open-job and add-candidate.
- hro_mgr_other_job (l.166): the own manager's move.
- hro_observer_readonly (l.175): "Rafael's identical successful requests are the control".
- hro_candidate_no_staff (l.184): a session control plus a same-kind staff control, with "A candidate who cannot sign in ... makes this row 0".
- hro_anonymous (l.193): "A signed-in success of each is the control" and an exact 401.
- hro_refusal_status (l.202): "If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0"; the status must match per role.
- hro_stale_refused (l.211): "The original successful move is the control". An app with no concurrency control accepts the legal replay and fails.
- hro_bulk_all_or_none (l.229) and hro_bulk_places (l.238): successful multi-card moves.
- hro_undo_conflict (l.256): an undo after an unrelated change goes ahead (same-kind control).
- hro_undo_once (l.265): "The successful undos are the control".
- hro_activity_refusals (l.283): "The successful actions' lines are the control". An app with no Activity gets 0.
- hro_notes (l.292): permitted notes by a Recruiter and the own manager.
- hro_msg_compose (l.319): blank message refused, "A normal send is the control".
- hro_unread_counts (l.346): count does not rise while open and own messages never count, vs count rises by two and "it appears" (prompt l.49).
- hro_unread_scrolled_up (l.355): place does not move vs a notice appears and the conversation is read after he goes to it.
- hro_seen (l.364): not seen after Observer only vs seen after Tomas, Bill and Rafael.
- hro_thread_access (l.373): Ingrid/Aud/Noor refusals vs "Rafael's own read and send are the controls" and Mei/Bill writes.
- hro_candidate_private (l.400): "own applications and conversations load ... (the control)", Rafael's identical read succeeded, and "A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0".
- hro_restart (l.418): "starting data is not loaded again" paired with seeded and created data being present after restart.

Polish (polish/judge.toml):
- pol_live_board and pol_live_thread: "If no update arrives within 15 seconds ... this row is 0", so a dead live feed cannot earn the not-lost-focus/draft legs.
- pol_earlier_place: earlier messages must load above.
- pol_failed_send: "Remove the interception and send again: it is sent once".
- pol_session_resume: "nothing was sent" is paired with the reply sending after re-sign-in ("which is the positive control"), and "Mei sees neither draft" is paired with Rafael's drafts still being there.
Visual is Likert craft only, with no negative legs.

Plausible broken apps tried:
(a) A server that returns 403 for every write. It passes the gates' reads but fails the gate add, so binary 0 throughout.
(b) An app with no role checks that refuses every move with 409. It fails the Rafael controls, and prompt l.17 discounts out-of-date refusals.
(c) An app with no Activity or unread feature. It fails the positive legs of activity_refusals, unread_counts and seen.
(d) An app where the Observer login silently fails. hro_observer_readonly has no explicit in-row Observer session control, unlike hro_candidate_no_staff (l.184). However, the replay "in the Observer's session" cannot be performed, so prompt l.25 fails the skipped step. A 401 instead of 403 is also deducted in hro_refusal_status, and Observer reads are graded in hro_notes and hro_activity. This is a non-blocking asymmetry (P3): adding "the Observer first signs in and reads the board (session control)" to hro_observer_readonly would mirror l.184.
Conforming alternative: an app that hides refused controls is explicitly allowed ("hiding it is optional"; prompt l.31). Replay then supplies the server observation, with Rafael's legal request as the control, so a conforming app is not failed.

Colderwater lessons checked for this row:
- 7/14: timed negative legs have defined void/repeat handling plus a full-window watch and reload.
- 9: the report-every-step rule is present (prompt l.23-25).
- 15: restart pairs "not loaded again" with re-reading several created records.
- 16: duplicate deduction is excluded ("Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row", l.31; l.202).
No instance in the row's scope lets a dead feature earn credit for absence.
suggested_fix: Optional (P3, non-blocking): in hro_observer_readonly add an explicit Observer session control ('Aud first signs in and reads the board; an Observer who cannot sign in makes this row 0'), mirroring hro_candidate_no_staff.
